candidate: Daer 2018 ten pTetR/B0034 synthases as absolute sender functions
reason: Receiver fluorescence after supernatant transfer is end-to-end evidence; intermediate HSL was not directly quantified.

candidate: Múgica 2025 Lux/Rpa/Cin sender modules as absolute sender functions
reason: Communication was demonstrated, but intermediate AHL was not directly quantified.

candidate: Rai 2012 pTet-LuxI dose-response inferred from receiver fluorescence
reason: Terminal AHL was below HPLC sensitivity and receiver fluorescence was not converted with a same-condition calibration.

candidate: Kokarakis 2023 time series as u→x function
reason: Time is an experimental axis under fixed induction, not a controlled sender-input dose series.

candidate: van Aalst 2025 C8-HSL data as runtime function
reason: Each construct has only two methionine conditions; distinct constructs cannot be pooled as expression levels.

candidate: van Aalst non-detecting LuxI/LasI/EsaI yeast strains encoded as zero-output functions
reason: No numeric LOD was reported; non-detection cannot be converted to zero.

candidate: Morohoshi deletion strains as promoter-strength series
reason: Deletion strains are different genetic contexts and fixed endpoints, not levels of one controlled expression input.

candidate: Kang supplement panel as one continuous sender function
reason: SAM, methionine and tyrosine combinations are heterogeneous categorical interventions and include different timepoints.

candidate: Lindemann natural BjaI concentration as expression function
reason: Only a natural growth-associated concentration/range was reported.

candidate: BjaI cell-free kinetics as runtime sender function
reason: Reported parameters lack auditable raw rate points, R² and RMSE; cell-free turnover is not cellular extracellular concentration.

candidate: BmaI1 cell-free kinetics as runtime sender function
reason: Reported parameters lack auditable raw rate points, R² and RMSE; cell-free turnover is not cellular extracellular concentration.

candidate: AhyI cell-free kinetics as runtime sender function
reason: Only a partial parameter set was explicit; full substrate-inhibition parameters, raw points, R² and RMSE are unavailable.

candidate: NovIspR1 resin concentration series as production function
reason: XAD-16 changes signal capture/recovery and the experiment also compares different constructs/fractions; this is not an isolated synthesis-input relation.
Intermediate AHL concentrations were not independently measured.
Downstream naringenin/product outputs do not identify the intermediate AHL concentration.
Biofilm and threonine outputs cannot be converted to intermediate AHL concentration.

candidate: Zhai 2026 yeast RpaI platform as absolute sender function
reason: Exact auditable p-coumaroyl-HSL input-output points were not located.

candidate: ES-P1 engineered AHL bacteria reported as 530 nM in secondary snippets
reason: The numerical value could not be traced to an auditable primary table/figure with construct and unit context.
